integrity: Formulas proved symbolically by a complete minimal-monomial-generator and pair-lcm-syzygy analysis. Independently constructed finite-field linear-system checks test sample inputs but are not universal proofs. Independent mathematical validation and definitive priority not established.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic-zero higher-leg (at least four) monomial spider algebras only. First-order embedded and abstract deformation characters; no obstruction groups, versal base, actual smoothing dimensions, or independence certification. The three-leg tangent-dimension case is known from Hu and Jelisiejew--Ramkumar--Sammartano. General prior monomial tangent character methods could already imply specializations.
title: Equivariant first-order deformation characters of higher-leg spider algebras
